description: Most marketing sounds polished. But it doesn’t feel personal. And if people can’t feel your message, they won’t trust it. Here’s the fix: be specific. Not “I help entrepreneurs grow their business.” Instead: “I work with coaches who post every day, get zero leads, and book their first three sales calls in seven days.” That’s a picture people can actually see. Generic is forgettable. Specific is believable. So next time you write, ask yourself: 1. What exact pain are they in? 2. What exact shift did you make? 3. What exact result came from it? Cut the fluff. Make it real. Because when it feels real, people trust it. And trust is what drives action. 👉 More leads. More clients. Less overwhelm. Free course waiting in the bio. #marketingstrategy #brandingtips #contentcreation #digitalmarketing #smallbusinessmarketing #entrepreneurmindset #leadgeneration #copywritingtips #onlinegrowth
transcript: Most marketing sounds polished, but it doesn't feel personal. And that's a problem because if people can't feel your message, they won't trust it. So here's how to fix it. Make it specific. Instead of saying, I help entrepreneurs grow their business with proven strategies, try this. I work with coaches who post every day and still get no leads. We tweak their messaging and book their first three sales calls within 7 days. That is a picture that people can actually see. And when they see it, they start to believe that it could work for them, too. So here's your rule. Generic equals forgettable. Specific equals believable. Next time you write or record, ask yourself, what exact pain are they in? What exact shift did we make? What exact result came from it? Cut the fluff and make it feel real. Because when it feels real, people trust it. And trust is what drives action.
